notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-EndGame PvE-Champion PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE utility roll to deal with all Champion types in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Stasis builds. Deliverance is a precision fusion rifle, which are rated D-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being "useful if lower charge time is desired over high-impact". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, and a ×0.9 reduction in horizontal recoil as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are good by comparison with its peers - you can see them at https://destiny.report/w/768621510/deliverance and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/768621510 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. With precision frames, you need to worry less about recoil control for look to improve Handling or maybe Stability. As the battery perk, Accelerated Coils improves charge time by 40ms at the cost of ×0.98 base damage, or Enhanced Battery gets you to 7 or the maximum of 8 shots with a Backup Mag mod. For your anti-Champion roll, there's not much that helps in the first trait perk column - Compulsive Reloader provides +50 Reload Speed (+55 when enhanced) with a ×0.95 reload animation scalar when the battery is above 50% charge, or use Demolitionist for the instant magazine refill on grenade use as well as generating chunk grenade ability energy on kills. In the second column for the "stun every Champion" roll, Chill Clip applies +60 stacks of slow (freezing targets after 2 hits) within a 4m AoE for 4s on a hit - 8s with Whisper of Durance - with ammo in the top half of the base battery size. You'll pierce Barriers with the frame intrinsic, disrupt Overloads with Slow, and shattering after freezing an Unstoppable will stun it, so you can handle all champion types with one weapon. The Souldrinker origin trait restores up to +50HP on reload, depending on the proportion of the magazine landed as hits. If you're interested, community consensus is that the Vow of the Disciple raid's weapon shapes such as "Liberation", referenced in the flavour text, represent stages in the Witness's and Rhulk's philosophy regarding the universe. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Charge Time mod or your preferred choice to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Deliverance is our first “kinetic” legendary fusion rifle. [...] Much like the rest of this season, you want to craft one with arrowhead brake to get that recoil direction up. Slotting just a counterbalance mod would suffice but you lose out on all the spec mods or backup mag. I think harmony or adrenaline junkie are going to be your best perks for general utility and major killing. But chill clip in conjunction with stasis builds will be really strong together.". Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "For PvP Deliverance is more of a “kinetic” Likely Suspect than it is a “kinetic” Main Ingredient. That being said, it does now allow players the ability to use other weapons and create some loadout diversity. Demolitionist and tap the trigger are extremely strong pairings together. Successful warm-up is also good if you want to go on sprees, but the consistency of tap the trigger (even post nerf) is hard to pass up.". Recommended MW - Stability.

Inspired by DMB Player Versus Enemies Podcast 8. Shapeable through the Mars Relic. PvE first choice roll for end-game content. The first fusion rifle for your kinetic slot, with perfect recoil direction from the precision subtype intrinsic perk. Your choice of barrel and mag, but you might want stability to keep bolts together, or charge time to get your shots away as quickly as possible. Cornered and Surrounded pair well, giving a 40% damage boost (or 47% boost for the enhanced perk) when used with a Surrounded Spec mod. Recommended MW: Charge Time or Reload Speed, with a Surrounded Spec mod.

[YeezyGT's WQ] [MW: Charge] "Deliverance is a one-of-a-kind with an incredible suite of perks. It's difficult to recommend something specific, as there's a great deal of synergistic perk options here. Compulsive/Chill Clip is a Reservoir Burst-esque combo, without detrimentally increasing mag size. Cornered/Surrounded is a godly combo that cuts down Charge Time and massively increases damage output (Enhanced Surrounded + Spec is an ENORMOUS +47% buff), Demolitionist/Adrenaline Junkie have natural synergy, along with Demo/Chill Clip, Heating Up/Tap the Trigger, Perpetual Motion for consistency... Almost anything works here. Invest in getting that Charge Time down as far as you can while maintaining Range and bolt spread (Stability)." tags:god-pve
